name: UK inflation & rates
value: CPI 3.5% (Sep); Bank Rate 4%; Oct CPI 18 Nov
summary: UK CPI 3.5% in September; Bank Rate 4% after 5 Nov rise; BoE sees CPI near 5% by mid-2027; October CPI due 18 Nov
state: UK CPI inflation was 3.5% in September, inside the 2.5–4.0% Watch band, and the Bank of England raised Bank Rate by 0.25 points to 4% on 5 Nov by an 8–1 vote, projecting CPI near 5% by the second quarter of 2027 (Bank of England). Deutsche Bank expects October inflation to move higher (FXStreet, 11 Nov). The ONS publishes October CPI at 07:00 on 18 Nov; a print above 4% would cross the Alert line.
for_you: Rising rates tend to feed through to mortgage and loan costs, with people refixing mortgages most exposed. The Bank of England and ONS publish the official figures.
